scientific_integrity: The proof is algebraic from the independent sign--magnitude decomposition. Exact enumeration and rational-arithmetic checks reproduce the conditional covariance identity, the magnitude-only independence boundary, and the uniform-law specialization. No external or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires symmetry about a known center, finite positive second moment, no atom at the center, and an ordering determined without sign information. The result is an exact covariance identity, not a claim of full joint independence or positive association between the runs statistic and centered sample variance.
title: Sign-blind runs couple to sample variance through adjacent magnitudes
